Bill Hagerty official Senate portrait, 117th Congress (cropped).jpg | nominee1 = [[Bill Hagerty]] | party1 = Republican Party (United States) | popular_vote1 = | percentage1 = | image2 = Marquita Bradshaw at Morristown (cropped).jpg | nominee2 = [[Marquita Bradshaw]] | party2 = Democratic Party (United States) | popular_vote2 = | percentage2 = | map_image = | map_size = | title = U.S. Senator | before_election = [[Bill Hagerty]] | before_party = Republican Party (United States) | after_election = | after_party = }} {{ElectionsTN}} The '''2026 United States Senate election in Tennessee''' will be held on November 3, 2026, to elect a member of the [[United States Senate]] to represent the state of [[Tennessee]]. [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] incumbent [[Bill Hagerty]] is seeking a second term. He is being challenged by [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic]] activist [[Marquita Bradshaw]] in a rematch of [[2020 United States Senate election in Tennessee|2020]]. In the August 6 [[primary elections]], Hagerty was unopposed the Republican nomination. Bradshaw won the Democratic nomination over former state party director Maria Brewer with 54.8% of the vote.
